snippet.title: Roots Devour | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Roots Devour, the strategic exploration card game developed by Rewinding Games and published by GCORES PUBLISHING, will be released on January 27 at 9 PM (EST) / January 28 at 2 AM (GMT), for the PC Steam platform. #indiegame    #strategy    #strategygames   

🩸Roots Devour is a strategic exploration game focused on a card-connection mechanism, around which it fuses elements of strategy, adventure, resource management, and deck building. You will play as a newborn eldritch, stretching your root to connect with every pitiful creatures around you. Devour everything to extend your roots further, until you explore and uncover the truth behind.

Roots Devour is priced at $14.99 USD. For the first two weeks following the launch, players can enjoy a 10% discount, bringing the price down to just $13.49 USD.

Wishlist Roots Devour on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2612690/Roots_Devour/
#indiegame  #lovecraftian  #strategygames  #strategy
